mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 78 degrees with clear skies near the Public Library, and we are currently in the third quarter moon phase.

The Verona Senior Center is now offering free tri-shaw bike rides along the Military Ridge State Trail, while the city is also accepting applications for a rain barrel rebate program to help with stormwater management.
Today you can head to Hop Haus or Wisconsin Brewing Company for trivia nights, and tomorrow brings even more fun with the Downtown Farmer's Market and Wednesday trivia at The Bogey Factory.
During the early hours of July 31, a vehicle stop resulted in the arrest of a driver for O W I and multiple traffic citations.
Today's flavor is the classic Butter Pecan at Culver's of Verona. They are open until 10 PM, so there is plenty of time to stop by for a scoop.
